full_name: Mary Channen Caldwell | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Humanities Rieman and Baketel Fellow for Music University of Pennsylvania
bio: Mary Channen Caldwell is an associate professor of music at the University of Pennsylvania whose research focuses on medieval song, devotion, and the cultural work of music across religious traditions.
